systematic_precision_defects: Mutation-like names can still outrank function-body semantics, producing write claims for pure string construction.
ADK destination provenance can be lost through environment/global configuration and delegation, promoting operator-configured endpoints to arbitrary egress.
Semantic names such as send_email can manufacture external-write authority without a source-visible send or network side effect.
recall_gaps: OpenAI Agents MCP collection factories can bind concrete MCP server lists to Agent(mcp_servers=...) while effective-authority relationships disappear.
OpenAI Agents awaited/composed dynamic tool collections such as provider_tools + [static_tool] can produce zero authority relationships.
Pydantic AI cross-file Tool(function, ...) wrappers can preserve tool identity while losing the wrapped function's side-effect semantics.
Pydantic AI decorated tools can lose transitive side effects performed by imported helper functions.
Some relationships survive only with empty capability, resource, or destination dimensions, so inventory recall remains stronger than authority recall.
